heard: Sons of Judah, line by line, Aaron and Sheva shined. Bathsheba gave these three, the firstborn heir was not seen. By the Lord with favor known, his path ended, it is so. Tamar bore Perez in Zerah, Judah had five sons, no fear Perez gave Hezron, Hamu, Hezron's firstborn, Ram the full Buna, Orin, Ozem, Lijah, Ram's sons, Ma's jammy knicker Jaramil had a Torah too, she was on Amzma
